note: Strings that would smuggle a second command, a version control write or a protected write past a classifier that reads only the first word (amendment 33.7, CP-S7 test 2). Every one of them is denied under the POSIX family, and the code says which layer caught it. Control characters are written as escape sequences so the file stays text.
